variants.notes: Verified from the analyzed bootloader/authenticated payload package plus application MPU/reset-lifetime analysis. The canary observation cell is separately verified unused and readable on this Sienna. The command-5 proxy contract is Sienna-specific: dispatcher 0x88350 record 0 resolves to adapter 0x87CCC and completion callback 0x88B5C; FEBF13BC/13BD are record-0 done/status cells; FEBFFB80..FEBFFBFF has no canonical application direct references, lies above the startup shadow-copy end, and is inside the no-SA XCP read/write window. The command-5 mailbox overlaps the canary observation cell, so canary and proxy variants are mutually exclusive.

The earlier FEBF0000 static pocket is explicitly disproved as a retained carrier: real stock startup overwrites it. Authenticated boot staging at FEBF0000/0x1000 and callback cell FEBF0FD0 remain valid bootstrap facts but are not the production retained VMA. Exact F33 application XCP can statically write FEBF7C00..FEBFFBFF, but live transport reachability and an application-mode control-transfer pivot into the high tail remain separate open gates.
